turns: Under what conditions does the default composite router abandon its primary router and degrade to another implementation, and what gets slower or behaves differently after that switch?

criteria: Identifies SmartRouter's registration-time detection of a router that cannot handle all routes (e.g. too many static routes for RegExpRouter) as the fallback trigger, not runtime request failures.
Explains that after falling back the app degrades from the optimized matcher to the LinearRouter/trie-style fallback with slower per-request matching.
Anchors the mechanism in src/router/smart-router source rather than README marketing text.
